zh: # Flipper Zero 固件 - [Flipper Zero 官方网站](https://flipper.net) - 向朋友简单介绍 Flipper Zero 能做什么。 - [Flipper Zero 固件更新](https://flipper.net/pages/downloads) - 为你的小海豚带来改进：最新固件版本，以及 PC 和移动设备升级工具。 - [用户文档](https://docs.flipper.net/zero) - 更多了解你的小海豚：规格、使用指南和各种问题。 - [开发者文档](https://developer.flipper.net/flipperzero/doxygen) - 深入 Flipper Zero 固件源代码：构建系统、固件结构等。 # 参与贡献 我们的主要目标是在 Flipper 周围建立健康、可持续的社区，因此欢迎各种新想法和贡献。这里也有一些规则和禁忌，请仔细阅读本页及我们的[行为准则](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)。 ## 我需要帮助 寻找答案的最佳位置是[用户文档](https://docs.flipper.net/zero)。如果找不到答案，请查看我们的 [Discord 服务器](https://flipp.dev/discord)。如果你想参与固件开发或根据需要修改固件，也可以查看[开发者文档](https://developer.flipper.net/flipperzero/doxygen)。 ## 我想报告问题 如果发现问题并想报告，请查看 [Issues](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/issues) 页面。请确保描述中包含所用固件版本、平台和清晰的复现步骤。 ## 我想提出新功能 如果有功能请求或想支持现有请求，请使用 [Discussions](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/discussions)，并遵循[讨论指南](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/discussions/4395)。 ## 我想贡献代码 提交 PR 前，请确认你的更改确实需要包含在固件中。许多想法可以轻松实现为外部应用，并发布在 [Flipper 应用目录](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipper-application-catalog)中。如果不确定，请通过 [Discord 服务器](https://flipp.dev/discord)或 [Issues](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/issues) 页面联系我们，我们会帮你找到适合代码的位置。 还请阅读[贡献指南](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/CONTRIBUTING.md)和[代码风格](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/CODING_STYLE.md)，并确保你的代码与[项目许可证](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/LICENSE)兼容。 最后，提交 [Pull Request](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pulls)，并确保 CI/CD 状态全部为绿色。 # 开发 Flipper Zero 固件使用 C 编写，部分使用 C++ 和 armv7m 汇编语言。建议具备中等水平的 C 语言知识，以便更顺畅地编程。Flipper 应用支持 C、C++ 和 armv7m 汇编语言。 ## 要求 支持的开发平台： - Windows 10+，带 PowerShell 和 Git（x86_64） - macOS 12+，带命令行工具（x86_64、arm64） - Ubuntu 20.04+，带 build-essential 和 Git（x86_64） 支持的在线调试器（可选但强烈推荐）： - [Flipper Zero Wi-Fi 开发板](https://flipper.net/products/wifi-devboard) - 兼容 CMSIS-DAP 的设备：Raspberry Pi Debug Probe 等 - ST-Link（v2、v3、v3mods） - J-Link Flipper 构建系统会处理其他所有依赖。 ## 克隆源代码 确保有足够空间，然后克隆源代码： ```shell git clone --recursive https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware.git ``` ## 构建 使用 Flipper Build Tool 构建固件： ```shell ./fbt ``` ## 使用在线调试器烧写固件 将在线调试器连接到 Flipper，然后使用 Flipper Build Tool 烧写固件： ```shell ./fbt flash ``` ## 使用 USB 烧写固件 确保 Flipper 已开机且固件正常运行。使用 USB 线连接 Flipper，然后使用 Flipper Build Tool 烧写固件： ```shell ./fbt flash_usb ``` ## 文档 - [Flipper Build Tool](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/fbt.md) - 构建、烧写和调试 Flipper 软件 - [应用](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/AppsOnSDCard.md)、[应用清单](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/AppManifests.md) - 开发、构建、部署和调试 Flipper 应用 - [硬件组合与解除变砖](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/KeyCombo.md) - 从严重故障中恢复 Flipper - [Flipper 文件格式](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/tree/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/file_formats) - Flipper 如何存储数据以及如何处理数据 - [通用遥控器](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/UniversalRemotes.md) - 为通用遥控器数据库贡献红外遥控器 - [开发者文档](https://developer.flipper.net/flipperzero/doxygen)中还有更多内容 # 项目结构 - `applications` - 固件使用的应用和服务 - `applications_users` - 放置额外应用和服务的位置 - `assets` - 应用和服务使用的素材 - `documentation` - 文档生成系统配置和输入文件 - `furi` - Furi Core：操作系统级原语和辅助工具 - `lib` - 项目自身及第三方的库、驱动、工具等 - `site_scons` - 构建系统配置和模块 - `scripts` - 辅助脚本及各种 Python 库 - `targets` - 固件目标：平台专用代码 更多细节也请参阅这些目录中的 `ReadMe.md` 文件。 # 链接 - Discord：[flipp.dev/discord](https://flipp.dev/discord) - Reddit：[reddit.com/r/flipperzero](https://www.reddit.com/r/flipperzero/) - 网站：[flipper.net](https://flipper.net) - Kickstarter：[kickstarter.com](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/flipper-devices/flipper-zero-tamagochi-for-hackers) ## 静态应用安全测试工具 - [PVS-Studio](https://pvs-studio.com/pvs-studio/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=open_source) - 用于 C、C++、C# 和 Java 代码的静态分析器。
en: # Flipper Zero Firmware - [Flipper Zero Official Website](https://flipper.net) - A simple way to explain to your friends what Flipper Zero can do. - [Flipper Zero Firmware Update](https://flipper.net/pages/downloads) - Improvements for your dolphin: latest firmware releases, upgrade tools for PC and mobile devices. - [User Documentation](https://docs.flipper.net/zero) - Learn more about your dolphin: specs, usage guides, and anything you want to ask. - [Developer Documentation](https://developer.flipper.net/flipperzero/doxygen) - Dive into the Flipper Zero Firmware source code: build system, firmware structure, and more. # Contributing Our main goal is to build a healthy and sustainable community around Flipper, so we're open to any new ideas and contributions. We also have some rules and taboos here, so please read this page and our [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) carefully. ## I need help The best place to search for answers is our [User Documentation](https://docs.flipper.net/zero). If you can't find the answer there, check our [Discord Server](https://flipp.dev/discord). If you want to contribute to the firmware development or modify it for your own needs, you can also check our [Developer Documentation](https://developer.flipper.net/flipperzero/doxygen). ## I want to report an issue If you've found an issue and want to report it, please check our [Issues](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/issues) page. Make sure the description contains information about the firmware version you're using, your platform, and a clear explanation of the steps to reproduce the issue. ## I want to propose a new feature If you have a feature request or want to vote on an existing one, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/discussions) and follow our [Discussion Guidelines](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/discussions/4395). ## I want to contribute code Before opening a PR, please confirm that your changes must be contained in the firmware. Many ideas can easily be implemented as external applications and published in the [Flipper Application Catalog](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipper-application-catalog). If you are unsure, reach out to us on the [Discord Server](https://flipp.dev/discord) or the [Issues](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/issues) page, and we'll help you find the right place for your code. Also, please read our [Contribution Guide](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/CONTRIBUTING.md) and our [Coding Style](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/CODING_STYLE.md), and make sure your code is compatible with our [Project License](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/LICENSE). Finally, open a [Pull Request](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/pulls) and make sure that CI/CD statuses are all green. # Development Flipper Zero Firmware is written in C, with some bits and pieces written in C++ and armv7m assembly languages. An intermediate level of C knowledge is recommended for comfortable programming. C, C++, and armv7m assembly languages are supported for Flipper applications. ## Requirements Supported development platforms: - Windows 10+ with PowerShell and Git (x86_64) - macOS 12+ with Command Line tools (x86_64, arm64) - Ubuntu 20.04+ with build-essential and Git (x86_64) Supported in-circuit debuggers (optional but highly recommended): - [Flipper Zero Wi-Fi Development Board](https://flipper.net/products/wifi-devboard) - CMSIS-DAP compatible: Raspberry Pi Debug Probe and etc... - ST-Link (v2, v3, v3mods) - J-Link Flipper Build System will take care of all the other dependencies. ## Cloning source code Make sure you have enough space and clone the source code: ```shell git clone --recursive https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware.git ``` ## Building Build firmware using Flipper Build Tool: ```shell ./fbt ``` ## Flashing firmware using an in-circuit debugger Connect your in-circuit debugger to your Flipper and flash firmware using Flipper Build Tool: ```shell ./fbt flash ``` ## Flashing firmware using USB Make sure your Flipper is on, and your firmware is functioning. Connect your Flipper with a USB cable and flash firmware using Flipper Build Tool: ```shell ./fbt flash_usb ``` ## Documentation - [Flipper Build Tool](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/fbt.md) - building, flashing, and debugging Flipper software - [Applications](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/AppsOnSDCard.md), [Application Manifest](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/AppManifests.md) - developing, building, deploying, and debugging Flipper applications - [Hardware combos and Un-bricking](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/KeyCombo.md) - recovering your Flipper from the most nasty situations - [Flipper File Formats](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/tree/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/file_formats) - everything about how Flipper stores your data and how you can work with it - [Universal Remotes](https://github.com/flipperdevices/flipperzero-firmware/blob/9981d9d4aa5ec7b14bb46cf15763dd293a7dec6a/documentation/UniversalRemotes.md) - contributing your infrared remote to the universal remote database - And much more in the [Developer Documentation](https://developer.flipper.net/flipperzero/doxygen) # Project structure - `applications` - Applications and services used in firmware - `applications_users` - Place for your additional applications and services - `assets` - Assets used by applications and services - `documentation` - Documentation generation system configs and input files - `furi` - Furi Core: OS-level primitives and helpers - `lib` - Our and 3rd party libraries, drivers, tools and etc... - `site_scons` - Build system configuration and modules - `scripts` - Supplementary scripts and various python libraries - `targets` - Firmware targets: platform specific code Also, see `ReadMe.md` files inside those directories for further details. # Links - Discord: [flipp.dev/discord](https://flipp.dev/discord) - Reddit: [reddit.com/r/flipperzero](https://www.reddit.com/r/flipperzero/) - Website: [flipper.net](https://flipper.net) - Kickstarter: [kickstarter.com](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/flipper-devices/flipper-zero-tamagochi-for-hackers) ## SAST Tools - [PVS-Studio](https://pvs-studio.com/pvs-studio/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=open_source) - static analyzer for C, C++, C#, and Java code.
